comment: Generic art catalogue (spec v3 7). Descriptions name themes and buildings only, never a project, a path or a conversation. scripts/art/prompts.py wraps each description in style, view and background.
style: Warm clay toy style: soft matte painted clay, rounded edges, gentle warm light from the upper left, soft ambient occlusion, muted terracotta, cream, sage and warm wood palette.
view: Strict isometric game-asset view (2:1 dimetric, camera looking from the south-east at 30 degrees elevation), the whole object fully visible and centred with generous margin, standing on its own small flat footprint.
background: Background: one flat uniform solid magenta colour #FF00FF filling the entire image, no ground beyond the footprint, no cast shadow on the background, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. Square image.

factions.claude-code: Its roof tiles and banners are terracotta red.
factions.codex: Its roof tiles and banners are slate blue.

publishing.name: 出版镇
publishing.town: It belongs to a cozy medieval PUBLISHING AND PRINTING town: cream plaster walls, timber framing, terracotta tile roofs, paper and ink details.

landmarks.idea: a PRINT HOUSE with a great wooden printing press under an open stone arch and paper sheets drying on lines across its balcony
a LIBRARY-SCRIPTORIUM with a tall round book tower, reading balconies and arched windows full of shelves
a TYPE FOUNDRY with a tall brick chimney, glowing crucibles and racks of small metal type blocks
a BOOKBINDERS' GUILDHALL whose roof is shaped like a giant open book, with leather hides drying outside
a PAPER MILL beside a small stream with a big turning water wheel and stacks of fresh paper
a NEWS TOWER with a clock face without numerals and a pulley lowering paper bundles from its balcony

craftsmen.town: It belongs to a cozy medieval CRAFTSMEN town: grey stone bases, warm wood beams, moss-green shingle roofs, tools and timber.

public.read: A single public building: a small round LIBRARY tower with tall arched windows showing bookshelves inside and an open book carved over the door.
public.edit: A single public building: a BLACKSMITH FORGE with an open front showing a glowing furnace, an anvil with a hammer in front and a stone chimney (no smoke).
